en.localOnlyBody: To protect host configuration, plugin management is only available from a local browser.
en.noUpdates: The installed version is the latest.
en.restartDesktopHint: Choose Restart in the system dialog that follows.
en.restartHint: Plugin changes take effect after restarting the application.
en.restartManualHint: This process cannot restart itself; restart DSH yourself.
en.restartPlanManual: This process cannot restart itself; restart DSH yourself.
en.restartPlanRelaunch: The DSH service restarts; running tasks are interrupted.
en.restartPlanShell: The desktop app performs the restart: confirming stops the host process and the shell brings a new one up.
en.restartRelaunchHint: Restart requested; reload the page once the server is back.
en.restartShellWarning: It also writes a crash report. You can instead restart manually: quit DeepSeek Harness (Cmd+Q) and open it again.
en.thirdPartyOnly: Third-party plugins only; @deepseek-ai/ packages upgrade with DSH itself.
en.updateBlockedDsh: Requires DSH >= {min}; upgrade DSH before updating
en.updateUnverifiedDsh: Cannot verify this host against the declared DSH range (this update needs DSH >= {min}); update paused
en.updateUnverifiedDshUnknownRange: Cannot verify the DSH range this plugin declares; update paused
